src: monochrome regions with T-shaped color-1 control markers
transform: recolor the region pointed to by each T stem using the original color from the two diagonal source cells behind the stem; colored-center T markers use the center color instead; erase marker cells into the source-side region
grid_shape: same, except rotate 90 degrees when indicated by the colored-center control orientation
notes: small non-rectangular colored scraps are absorbed into the neighboring region
